flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/{form/Form,detail/{Preview,NoticeDetails,NoticeODetails,VehicleDetail},hook/{ActionNotice,ActionNoticeUpload},mode/upload/{UploadPreview,ListValid,ListError,UploadView}}.tsx. ocmsadminapi: not used for the summary (summary data comes from the form state in the browser). Other repos: not used
note: stories.json status is 'Fully paid', demo_remark is empty. For manual entry there is a read-only Summary tab (Preview) that shows every value entered, but the tab is optional: the Submit button sits above the form and directly raises a generic confirmation modal 'Are you sure you want to create this notice?' with no summary inside. For upload, the preview page (valid and error lists) must be passed before Submit, but its table has only 4 columns (vehicle number, type, date-time, rule code); full detail per row is on the View page. No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Claim with a note: a summary exists (Summary tab for manual entry, preview page for upload), but it is not forced before confirmation on manual entry and the upload preview table has only 4 columns

steps.step: After keying in one notice, the officer can open the Summary tab that shows the offence details entered
steps.detail: The 'summary' tab exists in CREATE mode (Form.tsx:285-290) and renders Preview: NoticeDetails, NoticeODetails (date, time, car park, parking lot, rule code, composition amount, warden, remark, photo/video; NoticeODetails.tsx:45-132), VehicleExtraDetail (vehicle number; VehicleDetail.tsx:115-120), and Coupon/REP details when filled (Preview.tsx:41-77). Everything is read-only from the form state.

steps.step: The officer confirms creating the notice after viewing the summary
steps.detail: The Submit button sits at the top of the form for every tab (Form.tsx:105-112). Submit validates the form and then opens the modal 'Are you sure you want to create this notice?' (ActionNotice.tsx:114-141, 181-206). The modal contains no summary and no step forces the officer to open the Summary tab first, so confirmation can happen without seeing the summary.

steps.step: After uploading the file, the officer sees a review page with every uploaded row
steps.detail: Once the file passes, onProceed takes the officer to the preview route (SheetUpload.tsx:140-144; App.tsx:144). UploadPreview shows ListValid titled 'Review Uploaded Parking Offence Notices (n)' and ListError with Failed rows and the reasons (UploadPreview.tsx:30-50; ListValid.tsx:68-79; ListError.tsx:38-50). The Submit button exists only on this page (ListValid.tsx:70), so the review must be passed.

steps.step: The upload review shows the offence details of each row
steps.detail: The review table has only 4 columns: vehicle number, notice type, offence date-time and rule code (ListValid.tsx:80-108). Car park, composition amount, warden and other fields are visible only by opening the View page of each row, which renders the full Preview (UploadView.tsx:29-90). There is no single view with all details of all rows.

steps.step: The officer confirms creating all uploaded notices
steps.detail: Submit on the review page refuses when error rows remain ('Total of n record(s) have found error') or when there are no rows, then opens the modal 'Submit Case(s) - Are you sure you want to submit the notice(s)?' (ActionNoticeUpload.tsx:183-212). The modal holds only the question; the summary is already on the review page behind it.
